# Workspace instructions

- This workspace contains the Jafes Healthcare frontend demo, built with React and Vite.
- Keep the storefront responsive, keyboard-accessible, and consistent with the existing CSS design system.
- Current cart, chat, and prescription form are client-side demos only. Do not imply that they submit real orders, securely handle health data, provide medical advice, or fulfill prescriptions.
- Any production integration involving prescriptions or patient information must use secure services and pharmacist review, and meet applicable pharmacy, privacy, and payment requirements.
- Verify changes with `npm run build` and `npm run lint` when appropriate.
